description: Escape of water from Flat 4 through the kitchen ceiling of Flat 3 (reported by the Flat 3 occupier by phone 19:35 Sat 10/10). Tenant away 9-12 Oct.

history.note: Swift assigned as emergency. Key holder sent for emergency entry. Tenant called (voicemail), SMS and email sent.

Entered with key holder. Stopcock off. Cause: failed compression joint on the cold feed under the kitchen sink. Joint replaced, water back on, no further leak. Photos taken. Failed joint kept. Left 21:40.
Landlord Ben Hartley emailed: leak stopped, Flat 3 kitchen ceiling damaged, insurance claim likely on the Hartley Homes block policy.
Ben Hartley: thanks, I've notified my insurer myself, claim ref with them. Go ahead and pay Swift.
Amelia back home. Confirms kitchen dry under the sink, no leak, thanks for sorting it.
